The integration of large language models (LLMs) with code interpreters and development environments has given rise to a new class of AI systems known as "code agents." Code agents operate in increasingly complex and interconnected environments, often with access to system APIs, databases, and network resources. The field of red-teaming—systematically probing AI systems for vulnerabilities—has emerged as a critical discipline for ensuring the safe deployment of AI technologies. This approach enables systematic and scalable safety assessment of code agents, significantly improving upon manual red-teaming methodologies.
